fixed_eval.root_cause: The gymtorch global inference_mode makes eval env.step/reset in-place tensor updates fragile; the play.py path works (it uses the env's own step loop) but a standalone eval harness re-entering step needs the inference_mode context held consistently across reset+step+read, which interacts badly with the gym C++ state.
fixed_eval.blocking: Fixed 5-seed eval metrics cannot be collected this round. This is an eval-tooling gap, not an AMP/algorithm/data defect.
